The Wild West Map has just hit town, and it's a real humdinger! We're talking 5 diverse regions to explore, each with its unique flavor. Grind on epic rail carts!
Show off your ridin' skills with horse races!
Hang on tight while train surfin' (don't tell the conductor)!
Unlock a brand new boat to conquer those rivers!

And let's not forget the loot! We've got a treasure trove of 89 new items to collect, including classic revolvers and shotguns, sneaky bows and arrows, and even a trusty lasso to wrangle those pesky critters. Plus, if you're feeling a little explosive, there's always some good ol' TNT to settle things the Wild West way!

New bosses and mini-bosses are waiting to test your grit – can you tame the Wild West?

This is the biggest update Bang-On Balls has ever seen, so saddle up and get ready for a rootin' tootin' good time! Yeehaw!

notes.title: Bang-On Balls: Chronicles - Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
We are excited to roll out the latest hotfix for Bang On Balls: Chronicles on Steam to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gaming adventure. Thanks to your continuous feedback and our team's relentless effort, we have been able to address several issues that were impacting your gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/698604918a540fb0337321a10d2ce20145f49708.png[/img]

Here’s a sneak peek into the bug-bashing saga:

[list]
[*] Gave a good talking to the Roman Boss who was sometimes playing hard to get, and now the fight kicks off like a charm!
[*] Fixed the sneaky USA Control room Alien boss who thought it could hide below ground. Not on our watch!
[*] Sorted out the flag mix-up in split-screen travel. Player 2, your flag is yours again!
[*] Noticed some levels going all moody and dark in split screen? We brought back the lights!
[*] Spruced up Co-op Player 1's camera. No more peeking through trees or other weird stuff!
[*] Plugged up the cheeky spots in Japan that were trying to send you to the core of the earth.
[*] Waves now make a splash when client players do a boat slam in the water. Surf’s up!
[*] No more low-res surprise when switching to co-op, the visuals stay crisp.
[*] International pals, we’ve dialed up the connectivity so you can join the bash without a hitch!
[*] Co-op Player 2 will now chill in the diorama hangar when back at the main menu. As it should be!
[*] Made those shy alien spheres visible to client players. Peek-a-boo!
[*] And oh, the Toxic Boss Frog now finishes its dramatic entry before jumping into combat. The show's over, time to fight!
[/list]

Keep the feedback coming, we're rolling this ball together!

notes.title: April Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, fellow Bobs![/h3]

We're thrilled to announce a new patch for Bang-On Balls: Chronicles, jam-packed with exciting new features and over 430 bug fixes! 

We couldn't have done it without our amazing community's support and feedback. So, without further ado, let's dive into the list of changes:

[b]New Features & Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Added [b]split screen co-op[/b] so you can play with your lil' sister or bro on one PC!
[*] Experience a [b]new dynamic Main Menu[/b] that evolves as you progress in the game.
[*] Face off against the [b]new bad guy, BobBoss[/b], who gets more annoyed and changes appearance as you beat him.
[*] Enjoy the company of [b]new AI types[/b] like Fans, Paparazzi, Actors, Staff, and Producers.
[*] Celebrate your fame by surrounding yourself with Fans and [b]seeing your image on billboards[/b].
[*] Watch the [b]new Intro sequence cutscene[/b] that changes as you unlock items.
[*] Learn the ropes with a [b]new Tutorial[/b] and new items.
[*] Bring [b]dioramas[/b] to life as you unlock them with reels found in levels.
[*] Chill out in a [b]new Zoo[/b] and enjoy the [b]new Pet mechanic[/b] to catch and keep golden animals.
[*] Discover an [b]updated Arcade area[/b] with new bowling lanes and punching game.
[*] Try the [b]redesigned Special Mode[/b] triggered by grabbing a star.
[/list]
[b]Visuals, UI & Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Navigate with ease through the [b]UI overhaul[/b] for each map.
[*] Experience [b]improved framerate[/b] with streaming added to all levels.
[*] Marvel at the [b]improved camera behavior[/b] and new loading screens.
[*] Easily smash and blow up cars.
[/list]
[b]Customization & Content Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Customize your character with [b]new customization options[/b] like tattoos, colors, and flags (Moldova, Georgia, Armenia, North Macedonia, Montenegro).
[*] Uncover a [b]new secret moon[/b] and various new items.
[*] Mix and match [b]splitting items[/b] for better customization.
[*] Enjoy [b]improved Farting[/b], including during special mode (use at your own risk).
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes & Upcoming Content[/b]
[list]
[*] We've squashed over [b]430 bugs[/b]!
[*] Added the [b]Japan Hangar[/b] (that's a tease of our next update, yes)
[/list]
Also, here's a fresh playthrough of the update from our development team, showcasing all the new features and improvements.

[previewyoutube=YRKDa1AI5PU;full][/previewyoutube]

So jump back into Bang-On Balls: Chronicles today and let the good times roll!

Stay awesome, Bobs!

[i]Exit Plan Games & Untold Tales[/i]

notes.title: Special Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Celebrate Halloween and Dia de los Muertos the Bang-On Balls way![/h1] 

Boo! It is the season for scares and sweets, so Exit Plan is bringing a sackful of both with their new Bang-On Balls: Chronicles Halloween update running October 27 through November 5. Starting now you can find plenty of Halloween treats waiting for you in the lobby and the Viking chronicle. Whether it is candy corn collecting treats, pumpkin smashing tricks, new masks or new costumes, this update has lots to keep you amused while they wait for the upcoming Space Race chronicle (coming really soon). 

[b]Spooky Halloween update includes the following challenges and cool items:[/b]
[list]
[*] Find all 13 candy corn on the main menu to unlock the candy corn costume.
[*] Smash all 30 pumpkins placed around the Viking level to unlock the pumpkin costume.
[*] Frankenstein head and Día de los Muertos masks can be found in the main menu.
[*] Traders located on the main menu will give you some cool items in exchange for blue pips.
[*] Witch potion to turn your enemies into bats.
[*] Coffin shield with its little pet spider.
[*] Vampire mask with a cute little cape.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/d7ebc7b1f8a09d7a81bfe52fbbe015f0777c9356.png[/img]

On top of the cool Halloween update, and in preparation for our next big update, the team has been hard at work optimising the game.

TLDR: More Balls, faster FPS, very smooth.

[b]Here are some of the major improvements.[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where save files could become corrupted and players were stuck in the main menu.
[*] Added a new pool system (not of the swimming kind) that puts AI balls and their items (hats, moustaches etc) into a memory pool, in order to make it cheaper when spawning those AI from the pool (less stutter 10/10) 
[*] Multiplayer optimization to reduce stutter between Host and Clients.
[*] Added a ping check that will avoid connecting to other users with too high pings (You can still connect to your friend many countries away, via Steam friends).
[*] Improved pip performance to make sure they don’t eat your frames (om-nom-nom-nom).
[*] Animating balls is now more performant (we have also added new animations, including a rather cute “fleeing” animation).
[*] Painting dirt where you walk is now also cheaper, for those of us who don’t have 5 RTX graphic cards installed :)
[*] Chest optimization (same amount of pips in them, but less expensive on the CPU)
[*] Bunnies jumping now no longer makes your frames jump with them.
[/list]
Thank you all for your support :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/d2e1dc3091941892c2894bac1e47c2017c7f6aee.png[/img]

notes.title: Football Challenge update!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Kick some balls with the new Football Challenge!!
[/b][/h2]

The devs at Exit Plan Games have been watching UEFA EURO 2020 to see which team would take the cup. As big fans of football we wanted to bring the excitement of the tournament to players of Bang-On Balls: Chronicles with a new football mini-game in time for the Euro 2020 and Copa finals!. Whether you’re watching the Euros or Copa, now you can play out the finals or choose the teams you think “should” have made it if it wasn’t for the referee making that terrible call! He was clearly off-side! How could…. ahem Sorry, emotions are still a little raw. Anyways, now players can enjoy some in-game, bang-on soccer fun!

[list]
[*] [i][b]A New Kick in the Balls:[/b][/i] The new football mini-game is all about scoring as many goals as you can within the time limit, the more you score the bigger your reward! No 0-0 ties here, just goals, goals, goals! Playable solo or for up to 4 football fans in co-op, players can access the new mini-game by jumping into the football arcade machine situated in the studio lobby, near the recently added arcade challenge machines. 
[/list]
Give them all a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/ef817b0fdd60cf8f350835d4be78f9dff2a7c230.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Arcade Challenges update!

[/b][/h2]

Two new arcade machines have appeared in Bang-On Balls: Chronicles ! Offering new challenges to beat solo or with friends, and new amazing items to unlock.

The arcade machines are located at the back of the set, next to your boss, bypass him, select a machine and jump straight into the Arcade Challenges!

[*] [i][b]Ultimate Bang-On Mega Bricks: [/b][/i]Stuck inside a tetroid brick world, you must survive the multiple challenges in order to receive the ultimate reward. Bricks disappear from under you, and are thrown at you, bombs will try to push you off the arena. Do you have what it takes to survive each threat?
